subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: After the duplicate parser surface is removed and direct CLI proof is added, should OpenClaw adopt this experimental grouped Claw schema and plan-first CLI as the first implementation slice of the linked RFC?
rationale: The branch creates new CLI, environment-variable, manifest, and machine-readable output contracts whose long-term support and upgrade expectations cannot be determined by code correctness alone.

options.title: Accept after RFC approval
options.body: Approve the grouped one-Claw/one-agent contract through the RFC, remove the duplicate parsers, refresh proof, and then land this base slice.

options.title: Narrow the initial slice
options.body: Retain only the schema and inspection prototype while deferring add planning or other compatibility-sensitive output contracts until later design approval.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the implementation stack open but unmerged while the RFC and downstream ownership, migration, and lifecycle contracts mature.

recommendation.title: Accept after RFC approval
recommendation.body: Approve the grouped one-Claw/one-agent contract through the RFC, remove the duplicate parsers, refresh proof, and then land this base slice.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most detailed visible review of both the product model and this implementation's ownership boundaries.
